description: The donut chart, titled “Task Type,” visually breaks down the distribution of tasks performed by Agency B in the context of generative AI use in journalism, as detailed in the paper “Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism.” The chart is divided into three distinct segments: “Article generation,” represented by a large red segment accounting for 82.9% of the total; “Article editing,” shown in blue at 14.6%; and “Headline generation,” a small yellow slice representing 2.4%. The segments are arranged clockwise around the donut, with percentage values and labels clearly displayed adjacent to each corresponding slice. The central white space contains the title “Task Type” in bold black text, emphasizing the categorical nature of the data. The visual hierarchy strongly highlights article generation as the dominant task, with article editing and headline generation comprising significantly smaller proportions.
